profile: boosting: Boosting, also called forward stagewise selection, is a popular bottom-up feature-selection approach. It gradually builds a model one feature at a time by training a supervised learner sequentially, one weight at a time. Boosting builds up a single cross-validated model by gradually adding simple models consisting of a single universal approximator unit. It is presented as one of two popular feature-selection methods, alongside regularization.
